We are currently experiencing a power outage due to an issue with our power supplier. A vehicle hit a transmission pole on a transmission line that feeds multiple substations and serves several utilities throughout the area.
Our power supplier is working to assess the damage and restore service as quickly and safely as possible.
The current estimated time of restoration is approximately 30 minutes.
We appreciate your patience and understanding as we work with our power supplier to get service restored.
